title: Work orders of a deleted lead sit under Deleted technician, which takes no drops
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at location "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" (on another site: the location named in the test run).
  • Technicians "ZZAUTOTEST C614711 Dana" and "ZZAUTOTEST C614711 Eli" are active at this location with the "Technician" role. "ZZAUTOTEST C614711 Dana" was made for this case only and has no labor on any work order, because this test deletes that staff record.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST C614711 Deleted Lead" has two Approved work orders: unit "C614711-U1" led by "ZZAUTOTEST C614711 Dana", and unit "C614711-U2" with no lead technician.
  • Starting screen: your initials (top right) > "Settings" > "Staff", in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record named above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the pencil icon on "ZZAUTOTEST C614711 Dana".
  2. Click "Delete" and confirm.
  3. Go to "Work Orders" > "All" > "Board View".
  4. Type "ZZAUTOTEST C614711 Deleted Lead" in "Search".
  5. Read the header of the column that holds the card for unit "C614711-U1".
  6. Drag the card for unit "C614711-U2" from "Unassigned" onto that column and let go.
  7. Click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  8. Click "List" in the display switcher.
  9. Click "Board View" in the display switcher.
  10. Drag the card for unit "C614711-U1" onto "ZZAUTOTEST C614711 Eli"'s column and let go.
custom_expected:
Step 1: the staff record of "ZZAUTOTEST C614711 Dana" opens.

Step 2: "ZZAUTOTEST C614711 Dana" is no longer in the "Staff" list.

Step 3: Board View shows.

Step 4: the cards for units "C614711-U1" and "C614711-U2" show.

Step 5: the header reads "Deleted technician", shows the inactive marker and has no drag grip.

Step 6: the drop is refused: the card for unit "C614711-U2" stays in "Unassigned".

Step 7: unit "C614711-U1" sits in a group headed "Deleted technician" with the inactive marker.

Step 8: in the row for unit "C614711-U1" the "Lead Technician" cell is blank.

Step 9: Board View shows again.

Step 10: unit "C614711-U1" moves to "ZZAUTOTEST C614711 Eli"'s column and "Lead technician updated" shows.

Known problem SV-11416 (step 5): today the column reads "Unknown Technician" with a plain person icon, no inactive marker and a drag grip. If you see exactly that, mark this test Failed and raise nothing new.

AUTOMATION: READY - EXPECT FAIL (SV-11416)
